    • FAQs

      Questions you may have, answered with
      • What display technology is used in Samsung 43" TVs?
        Samsung 43" TVs typically use LED or QLED technology. LED TVs provide good picture quality and brightness, while QLED TVs offer enhanced color accuracy and better brightness control due to quantum dot technology.
        How'd we do?
      • Does the Samsung 43" TV support 4K and HDR?
        Most Samsung 43" TVs support 4K resolution, providing sharper and more detailed images. HDR (High Dynamic Range) is also commonly supported, enhancing the contrast and color of the picture.
        How'd we do?
      • What smart features are available on Samsung 43" TVs?
        Samsung 43" TVs often come with Tizen OS, offering features like voice control, integrated streaming apps, and compatibility with smart home devices. Check for updates and app availability.
        How'd we do?
